title: Shiny Key
summary: Opens the Shiny Chest in the Emerald Grove.

fields.Lock: Shiny Chest northwest of Topaz’s nest, on a stone pillar. Jump, use a mobility spell, or use Mage Hand to throw the chest down.
fields.Acquisition: Topaz’s nest at X 228, Y 492. Steal it or pass Persuasion or Deception while speaking with Topaz.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
